label: For "Alarm Correlation & Root-Cause Grouping": Group the alarms raised by one underlying fault across a multi-vendor network and rank the likely root element, so the NOC works one incident instead of thousands of alarms. Define the label exactly as in milestone M1: what counts as a positive or a correct outcome, and when it becomes known. Design around this trap first: Time-window correlation without topology.
